exposure: causal foods (cow's milk, beef, wheat, eggs, nuts)
absence of a pet at home
cohort: The study included 84 patients diagnosed with food protein-induced allergic proctocolitis (FPIAP) between March 2019 and March 2020, who had at least 3 years of follow-up.
finding: Tolerance development times to egg and nuts were longer than those to cow's milk, beef, and wheat in FPIAP, and delayed tolerance was associated with specific food combinations, multiple food allergies, atopic dermatitis at onset, absence of a pet, and IgE-mediated food allergy at onset.
